summary: Updates RFC 7450 (Automatic Multicast Tunneling) by changing relay discovery. It defines a DNS resource record, AMTRELAY, that publishes AMT relays for source-specific multicast channels in the reverse DNS zone of the sender's address.

eli5.summary: A phone book entry that tells you which helper to call to get a certain broadcast, found by looking up the sender's number.

questions: how are amt relays discovered with dns
